eps.d: When her inheritance is eaten up by her late husband's creditors, Audrey fforbes-Hamilton prepares to bid farewell to her beloved manor house, until a mysterious millionaire enters her life.
Audrey moves out of Grantleigh Manor. Her hopes of seeing the estate run along old lines are dashed when she discovers the new owner's background.
Audrey takes DeVere to task for failing to turn up in church on Sunday, but then fails to practise what she preaches.
DeVere moves his multinational grocery business to the manor and crosses swords with Audrey over a fireplace.
The summer ball for the local hunt is coming up, but with the change in ownership at Grantleigh, there's some confusion over who should arrange the event of the season.

Despite having come down in the world, Audrey feels appearances demand she take a holiday but dreads leaving her beloved Grantleigh Manor in DeVere's hands. So she picks the only safe week - when DeVere himself is on holiday.
When DeVere decides to film a commercial at the manor, Audrey thinks the world should know the truth about him - and about her.

Richard offers Ned's services to Audrey in Brabinger's absence but Ned thinks it is all a plot to remove him from his tied cottage so that the new farm manager can move in. Audrey decides to take her revenge.
One of Audrey's old school friends wants to pay a visit, but she is unaware of the drop in status of the former lady of the manor.
Audrey helps Richard catalogue his antique china, only to discover one piece has been mislaid.
Arthur arrives as usual to help out on the Grantleigh estate, but Audrey can't give him work.
Fearing that DeVere's plans to enlarge the fields will destroy the surrounding countryside, Audrey leads the local community's campaign to stop him.
Audrey puts her back out fetching in the firewood.
Audrey upbraids Richard for not sponsoring a charity event in aid of a new scout hut.
British Rail decide to close down the local station and Audrey goes into battle.
A repair bill for Audrey's Rolls-Royce finally convinces her to revert to four-legged horsepower.
Audrey starts a business selling honey. A rare bee-eating bird spotted by Marjorie brings lots of people to the village. Audrey sees this as an ideal opportunity to sell her honey.
DeVere negotiates an important business deal with the beautiful Mademoiselle Dutoit, but when she decides to mix business with pleasure, he invents a wife... Audrey!
Richard's business empire hits a serious crisis.
Audrey's hopes of regaining her position as lady of the manor look like being dashed when Richard's business crisis forces him to sell up.
